subject: CostIntel: FinCost pilot — vendor assessment & next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: CostIntel: FinCost pilot — vendor assessment & next steps

Team — quick recap from the pilot and my recommended path forward. I pulled together the raw metrics and a short compare sheet (attached). Key points: 

- Pilot coverage: 2 weeks, across search and batch-reporting workflows.
- Quantitative: 18% avg cost reduction on token-based jobs (batch), 9% latency improvement on P99 for interactive lookups. See pilot-metrics.csv for per-workload detail.
- Qualitative: Integration was straightforward, but there are gaps in RBAC/admin UI and export formats (we added a small ETL to normalize).

Given the outcomes, my recommendation is to move from pilot into a committed 12-month subscription for the core reporting workloads, with a conversion discount tied to usage tiers. We should ask FinCost for: 
  1) A firm price for 12 months + a short SOW that limits data retention to our policy.
  2) A migration credit for the engineering effort we incurred (small one-time).
  3) A roadmap commitment for the RBAC/admin features we flagged.

Marissa — can you own commercial negotiation? Karthik/Vivek — please confirm there are no technical blockers from infra/security. Grace, please stand by for procurement intake if we decide to proceed.

Attachments: pilot-metrics.csv, fincost-pricing-compare.xlsx

Thanks,
Soojin
Soohyun (Soojin) Lee
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CostIntel: FinCost pilot — vendor assessment & next steps

Agree with Soojin's assessment. A couple of commercial notes from my side after the pilot wrap call:

- FinCost is open to a 12-month commitment with a 20% conversion discount at $X/month floor; they proposed credits for implementation but left specifics open.
- They flagged that the RBAC work is backlog-prioritized — they can commit a timeline only with a signed contract.

Proposed negotiation play: ask for 25% discount on first-year committed spend tied to a 6-month performance review (conversion guardrails), plus a one-time $10k engineering credit and data-retention addendum. If they won't move on RBAC timeline, we should push for an SLA credit tied to feature delivery.

I'll take point on commercial. Next steps: I will draft a term sheet and loop in procurement/legal (Grace and Legal) and the FinCost AE. Can someone confirm the legal contact?

- Marissa

Subject: Re: CostIntel: FinCost pilot — vendor assessment & next steps

Marissa / Soojin — thanks for the thoughtful notes and for running the pilot with your team. Quick update from our side:

- Attached is a revised SOW and a pricing compare (fincost-revised-sow.pdf, fincost-pricing-compare.xlsx) that reflects a 22% conversion discount at the 12-month committed tier and a one-time $8k credit toward integration effort.
- RBAC roadmap: we can commit to a public beta of the admin console within Q4 and a generally available release within Q1, with the option for early access for anchor customers (we'd require a short NDA for roadmap details).
- Data retention: we can add the requested retention clause to the SOW (30/90/365 options) and sign an addendum that restricts export windows.

If this looks reasonable, let's schedule a 30-minute commercial+procurement call this week so we can get legal to start redlines. Proposed times: Wed 11am PT or Thu 9am PT.

Best,
Alex Ramirez
Head of Partnerships, FinCost.ai

Date: 2026-08-15T12:35:00-07:00
Subject: Decision: move to procurement intake for FinCost (12m committed)

Thanks everyone — after reviewing the revised SOW and the numbers from Alex, I'm authorizing a procurement intake to convert the pilot into a 12-month committed contract, conditional on final legal redlines. High-level commercial we accepted: 22% conversion discount + $8k integration credit; pilot KPIs will be used in the 6-month review clause.

Grace — please open an intake ticket and start vendor onboarding. Key asks for procurement/legal:
  - Confirm SOC2 posture and complete the security questionnaire (Alex said they'll provide evidence).
  - Add the data-retention addendum to cap retention to 90 days by default.
  - Include the roadmap NDA for early RBAC access (we will decide on NDA after legal review).

Marissa — please lead negotiation and coordinate redlines with Alex. Karthik/Vivek — if you see any outstanding technical risk, flag it in the procurement ticket; otherwise mark as approved from infra.

I'll track this as DEAL-4982-FC in HubSpot and will update the record with the SOW and pricing docs.

Thanks — moving forward.

Soojin Lee
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
